correctness.rationale: For K=2h in (0,2], the error u=theta-pi satisfies |u-K sin u|<|u| for 0<|u|<pi; compact strict descent gives global attraction excluding the in-phase fixed point. At K>2 the multiplier 1-K<-1 yields local repulsion. For h=1, g(v)=2sin(v)-v=v(1-v^2/3+v^4/60+O(v^6)); independent exact Taylor expansion gives w_{n+1}-w_n=2/3+3/(10w_n)+O(w_n^-2). Summing after w_n=2n/3+O(log n) yields w_n=2n/3+(9/20)log n+C+o(1). For fixed v0 in (0,1], at h=1-eps the positive decreasing recursion and uniform affine reciprocal-square expansion give eps*w_floor(t/eps)->(exp(4t)-1)/6. Finite-hitting seeds are separately excluded. Checked RESULT.md and verify.py actual frozen blobs; numerical meshes are corroboration, not proof.
